author: Riskayyy
body:
Thought about this for a while, and I believe it's time to spicy things up a bit. I mean, right now what you can do with YML is quite limited; depending on what you wish to implement...

I was discussing tiebreakers in the events chat, and I quickly suggested that having monuments switch positions after X minutes would be interesting.
Wouldn't it be cool if we could have more sub-gamemodes in Nebula?

Just a thought, I would definitely love more YML modules in the future :))
What's your opinion? Do you have any suggestions for modules?

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
+1 agreed!
I would love it when you can make something like:
Player A walks in Region A, then blocks in Region B get destroyed and if Player A leaves Region A the blocks in Region B gets replaced.

Another thing would be great, if Player A stands in Region A and after X amount of time the player scores Y amount of points for their team.

Edit: More Suggestions!
You can't/only can place a specific block in a region. Like you can build around the monument, but only with glass. Or you can't place wood on a path.
